name: Rolla's

prices.note: Not Shopify products.json; read from the US collection page's embedded search data (rollas_us_prod_products, 82 hits: 61 category Jeans, 21 Pants). All 61 jeans had compareAtPrice equal to price (regular). Many styles have a 'Long' version (34 in inseam). Waists 23–36 from 5 styles' variant lists.

notes: US homepage title: 'Rolla's Jeans USA | Denim that lifts, holds & flatters'. The default (AU) title: 'Rolla's Jeans | Australian Denim Classic Design Modern Fabrication' (hq_country AU; FashionUnited also lists it as Australian, founded by Andy Paltos and Sarah Gilsenan).
US shipping: free economy at $120+, $12 under; free expedited at $300+, $25 under. Regions: United States, Canada, Europe & Great Britain, Asia, rest of world. Dispatch cutoff is in AEDT.
Returns: within 30 days of delivery; standard return US$6–$10 (free with Checkout+); refund, exchange or store credit on full-price items; sale items not returnable.
